title: Welcome to Good News Rowlett
excerpt: A home for the good things happening in Rowlett – the neighbors, businesses and moments that make this town home.
body:
Scroll through some local Facebook groups and you might think nothing good ever happens in Rowlett. Anyone who lives here knows better.

Every week, a neighbor mows a yard for someone who's laid up. A local shop sponsors a Little League team. A teacher stays late. Someone opens a new restaurant on a dream and a lot of hard work. Those stories rarely trend, but they're the real Rowlett.

Good News Rowlett is where we'll collect them – short, true stories about the people and places that make this a great place to live, written so you can pass them along.

Here's what you'll find:

- New businesses opening, and milestones for the ones that have been here for years
- Neighbors helping neighbors
- Students, teachers, coaches and volunteers worth celebrating
- Community events, park improvements and things to do around Lake Ray Hubbard

What you won't find: politics, arguments or rumors. There are plenty of places for those already.

Have some good news? Share it with us. A few sentences and a photo is plenty. We'll check the details and give it the spotlight it deserves.

Thanks for reading, and thanks for choosing to see the best in Rowlett.
